body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>

Accton Technology has presented its desktop video phone (model: VD2706T) at CES 2006. With enhanced voice/video quality, this IP broadband videophone could be useful for conference call. It features convenient touch screen, built-in 300K pixel camera with hot key, built-in microphone/speaker.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliyah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
